fusions.name: Starved Bite
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A bite that deals 9 damage, heals you for 40% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Field Dressing
fusions.desc: Carves into an enemy at or below 30% health for 22 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. You heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Passing the Haunch
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds, and you regain 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Eat What You Kill
fusions.desc: Each kill restores 6 health. When you kill an enemy, healing you receive rises by 30% for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
